column1: # AT-V05: which features the differential corpora must contain (REQUIRED, with a minimum) and which areas are KNOWN to be empty (GAP,
# exactly zero). Checked by scripts/check-corpus-coverage.py against the corpus files themselves. A feature the corpus no longer
# produces fails a REQUIRED row; a GAP that has become covered fails its row (the manifest would otherwise claim a hole that is closed
# or, worse, report coverage that does not exist). Every row names the acceptance test (AT) and requirement it traces to.
# columns: feature <TAB> kind <TAB> AT <TAB> requirement <TAB> detector <TAB> min <TAB> note
# detectors: rows:<file> (non-empty lines) | rowsh:<file> (minus a header line) | distinct:<file>:<col> (distinct values, header skipped)
#            grep:<glob>:<regex> (matching lines) | steps:<scenarios.json>:<op> (steps with that op) | scenarios:<glob> (scenarios)
#            dar-lf:<dar>:<version> (1 when the DAR is that Daml-LF version)
